title: Front end developer | Immediate Joiner | Remote
description:
This is a remote position.

About The Role

We are looking for a high-level Front-End Developer who views web development as an art form. You aren’t just a coder; you are a bridge between sophisticated design and high-performance engineering.

As a member of our team, you will lead the charge in optimizing our React ecosystem, exploring new plugins, and ensuring seamless API integrations.

Key Responsibilities


Design-to-Code Mastery: Expertly translate high-fidelity Figma designs into clean, semantic, and modular code.
Architecture & Scaling: Develop and maintain complex web applications using React.js, focusing on state management and performance optimization.
Cross-Framework Versatility: While React is our core, your ability to navigate or migrate Angular environments is a significant plus.
Full-Stack Integration: Collaborate with backend teams to integrate RESTful/GraphQL APIs and ensure end-to-end data integrity.
Tooling & Extensions: Implement and build custom React plugins/extensions to enhance the development workflow.
Version Control: Manage complex branching, merging, and code reviews via Git.


Our Selection Process

We value your time and aim for a transparent, efficient hiring cycle.


Round 1: Practical Code Assessment : A real-world challenge focusing on Figma translation and React logic.
Round 2: Technical Deep Dive : A conversation with our Engineering Leads covering architecture, performance, and problem-solving.
Round 3: Final HR Interview : Discussion regarding culture fit, expectations, and immediate onboarding.


Requirements

Technical Requirements


Core Tech: 3-4+ years of experience with React.js, TypeScript, and modern CSS frameworks (Tailwind, Styled Components, or SASS).
Design Tools: Mastery of Figma (including Auto Layout, Components, and Prototyping).
State Management: Deep knowledge of Redux, Context API, or Zustand.
The "Plus" Factor: Proficiency in other front-end frameworks and a solid understanding of Node.js for backend collaboration.
Modern Workflow: Experience with Webpack/Vite, Unit Testing (Jest/Cypress), and CI/CD pipelines.


Benefits

Why Join Us?


Opportunity to work on cutting-edge products.
Fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Immediate Onboarding: We are looking for someone who can hit the ground running within [2 weeks/immediately].

Join us as a Software Development Engineer in our BT Development team at our Goa office to get the opportunity to do the best work of your career and make a profound impact in our journey of enabling retail in India.

What You’ll Achieve

As a Software Developer in our BT Development team in our Goa office, you will be working on (CakePHP/ Laravel, Yii/ Phalcon) and would have an opportunity to work with a leading retail software solutions company.

Collaborate with the product team to provide technical expertise on requirements.
Contribute significantly to the execution of the product roadmap by designing and implementing scalable backend modules and intuitive frontend components.

Participate in capacity planning and system optimization efforts as we scale.

Take this next step in your career with a steep learning curve and real ownership from day one.

Must have 2–5 years of experience in backend development using any one PHP 5+ framework (CakePHP/ Laravel/ Yii/ Phalcon).
Solid experience with MySQL and good understanding of relational databases.
Hands-on experience with Angular.js or React.js or Vue.js.
Strong knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3 for responsive web development.
Experience in building and consuming RESTful APIs.


Desirable Requirements


Exposure to Git/Jenkins or any other CI/CD tools.
Knowledge of AWS/Azure infrastructure services.
Working knowledge of Redis, Elasticsearch, or NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with secondary programming languages such as Python or Node.js.
Experience with performance profiling and optimization techniques.

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more!


Here’s our story; now tell us yours

“Ginesys One” is India’s best omniretail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200+ brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionise retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

Ginesys’ core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers.
